business_scope.primary_industry_name: Overseas Direct-Operated Hotpot Dining and Condiment Supply

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Independent State of Samoa (Malo Sa'oloto Tuto'atasi o Samoa)
meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state tax distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER-Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus; in force 13 December 2020)
Samoa-New Zealand Double Taxation Agreement (income tax, as amended)
Samoa-Norway and Samoa-Sweden limited double taxation agreements (international air transport profits)
Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with Australia and multiple EU/OECD jurisdictions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2020, as amended, together with the AML/CFT Regulations 2021; International Companies Act 1987, as amended (International Companies (Amendment) Act 2008 and subsequent revisions), imposing UBO certification obligations on licensed registered agents; Proceeds of Crime Act 2018; Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) AML/CFT Guidelines; Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) membership and implementation of FATF Recommendations 24 and 25.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Samoa International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Compliance/Status)
Certificate of Incumbency (directors, secretary, registered agent and UBO declaration)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed registered agent of record in Samoa
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by Samoan notary public + Hague Apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for overseas operating-company management, license applications and bank account opening
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Director(s) of the Samoa International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization + Hague Apostille (or consular legalization at a Samoan embassy/consulate for documents originating in non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolutions approving incorporation of the overseas hotpot restaurant operating entity, condiment supply chain arrangements and local merchant acquiring/POS payment rails
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Samoa International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified copy by registered agent + Hague Apostille

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, registered agents and every natural-person UBO against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, Samoa FIU sanctions notices, FATF public statements, OFAC SDN List, EU consolidated sanctions list and UK consolidated list; mandatory foreign and domestic PEP identification with enhanced due diligence on family members and close associates; verification of source of funds and source of wealth prior to incorporation; 25% direct, indirect and aggregate beneficial ownership calculation; nominee shareholding permitted only with executed written UBO declarations retained by the licensed registered agent.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry / International Companies Registry, Registry Division, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa; online name pre-search and reservation via www.mcil.gov.ws
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory legal name must be in Roman/Latin script; English text prevails for all registry filings. Chinese characters are not accepted in the registered statutory name but may be recorded as an adopted transliterated business name. The Articles of Association may be bilingual (Chinese-English) with the English text controlling for legal interpretation and statutory submission.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A reserved name is valid for 30 days and may be extended for successive 30-day periods by filing an extension request with the prescribed fee before expiry. Upon written rejection, the applicant may submit a reconsideration request to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 working days of the refusal notice; if the refusal is upheld, an administrative appeal may be lodged with the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days; ultimate recourse is judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa. To avoid delay, two alternative reserved names should be lodged simultaneously.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not permissible as the statutory registered office; the International Company must maintain a registered office at the physical premises of a licensed registered agent in Samoa. Virtual or service addresses may be used only for correspondence and managerial convenience. The operational head office of the overseas hotpot restaurant chain is outside Samoa and does not satisfy the statutory registered office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the Samoa International Company itself (estimated below 10% annual probability); the MCIL Registry and Samoa FIU inspect licensed registered agents rather than overseas restaurant premises. Unannounced host-country food safety, fire safety and trading-standard inspections of the hotpot restaurant operations are near-certain (greater than 90%) and are governed exclusively by the operating jurisdiction's authorities.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for certified bilingual corporate constitutional documents

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended; Sections 6 (Incorporation), 7 (Memorandum and Articles), 10 (Registered Office) and 41 (Directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company, filed with Application for Registration as an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; capital may be in any currency and need not be paid up upon incorporation, but a declaration of solvency and capital structure must be made in the Memorandum
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers listed in the Memorandum and Articles of Association be and are hereby allotted shares in the capital of the company as set forth in the register of allotments; RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the company be and is hereby established at the address of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa; RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name], [Name] and [Name] be and are hereby appointed as the first directors of the company, and [Name] be and is hereby appointed as Company Secretary; RESOLVED FURTHER that the directors are authorised to open bank accounts, execute lease agreements, and take all necessary steps to obtain licences for the overseas hotpot restaurant and condiment supply business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request via the online MCIL registry portal or in writing to the Registrar. The proposed name must include 'Limited' or 'International Company' suffix and must not be identical or confusingly similar to existing registered names in Samoa. Payment of the reservation fee is required. Upon approval, obtain the Name Reservation Certificate, valid for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Copy of passport of proposed director/shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, file a written appeal with the Registrar within 14 days or submit an amended name request; if the name is misleading, provide additional explanatory documentation to satisfy the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed international company service provider / notary public in Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed international company agent to prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association (M&A). The M&A must specify share structure, registered office address (c/o the agent), objects including full-service dining chain operation and condiment supply, and any limitation of liability. The M&A must be executed by the subscriber(s) in the presence of a notary public or witnessed by the licensed agent, with the subscriber's signature legally certified.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as director and secretary
Certified passport copies of shareholders and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries any M&A clause, amend the offending clause and re-submit within 14 days; if notarisation is deficient, obtain fresh notarised signatures and file an affidavit of execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed Application for Registration as an International Company together with the executed M&A, registered agent consent, and statutory declaration of compliance. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 150 (or equivalent in Samoan Tala) via approved bank transfer to the Ministry of Finance account. The Registrar may also require a certified copy of the agent's licence and a statement of non-offshore banking target.
required_dossiers: Application for Registration as an International Company (Form 1)
Memorandum and Articles of Association (certified copy)
Statutory declaration of compliance by subscriber/agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected, correct the stated defects in writing and resubmit within 21 days; if the Registrar issues a show-cause notice, provide legal submissions through the agent to demonstrate compliance with the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation under the official seal of Samoa, along with a certified copy of the M&A and company register opening. The licensed agent then prepares the corporate kit containing share certificates, statutory registers, and company chop. The company becomes a body corporate as of the date stated on the certificate.
required_dossiers: List of first directors and secretary (Form 3)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a typographical error, return the original certificate with a formal application for administrative correction to the Registrar within 7 days; no re-submission of full dossiers required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution and Commencement of Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors / Corporate Secretary, Samoa International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the inaugural board meeting physically or by written resolution. Adopt the pro-forma first board resolution approving share allotment, registered office address, appointment of officers, and authorisation to proceed with licensing and bank account opening. Record minutes in English, signed by the chairman, and file the Form 3 (List of Directors and Secretary) with the Registrar within 30 days of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting or written resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If Form 3 is not filed on time, file a late filing notice with an explanation and pay the prescribed late fee; if the Registrar rejects the resolution due to defective quorum, pass a conforming written resolution signed by all directors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) – Occupational and Business Licencing Section, Samoa
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Overseas Business Licence / Restaurant Operating Permit (Food Service Establishment Licence) under the Business Licence Act 1998 and Food Act 2015

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) – Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration/Low Impact – Category B (Food service and condiment production with minor wastewater discharge)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must meet Samoa’s National Water Quality Standards for biochemical oxygen demand (BOD5) ≤ 30 mg/L, suspended solids ≤ 50 mg/L, and pH 6.5-8.5; VOCs from cooking exhaust must be controlled through grease filters and extraction systems; solid waste and used cooking oil must be handled by licensed waste contractors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority; structural load inspection by the Engineering Section of MCIL for restaurant occupancy; occupational health clearance for ventilation, kitchen slip hazards, and food handler medical fitness under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2002.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MFOR), Apia, Samoa, headed by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue; official e-services portal: https://www.mfor.gov.ws (tax registration, return filing, payment and tax clearance certifications).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Samoa International Company (IC) is incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 through a SIFA-licensed registered agent and receives a Company Number; no MFOR tax identification number (TIN) is automatically issued. A standard IC carrying on business wholly outside Samoa is exempt from all Samoan taxes and is not required to hold a TIN or file Samoa income tax/VAGST returns. If the IC later derives Samoa-source income, carries on a taxable activity in Samoa, or makes taxable supplies in Samoa, the registered agent must file an MFOR taxpayer registration application accompanied by the certificate of incorporation, constitution, registered agent certificate, and director details; MFOR then issues the TIN. For banking and AML due-diligence purposes, the registered agent may obtain from MFOR a tax clearance or tax-exemption certificate confirming the IC's offshore exempt status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Samoan law. Statutory elections available under the International Companies Act 1987 and the Companies Act 2015 include: (i) election to convert an International Company into a domestic company; (ii) election to migrate or redomicile an International Company out of Samoa; and (iii) election of a domestic company to register as an International Company. Any such election is lodged through the licensed registered agent with the Registrar and notified to MFOR, and it commences or terminates the tax-exempt status accordingly; a Samoan International Company has no transparent or pass-through tax election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST - Value Added Goods and Services Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 of taxable supplies in any 12-month period for a person carrying on a taxable activity in Samoa; a non-resident carrying on a Samoan taxable activity is registrable on the same threshold and voluntary registration is permitted. A tax-exempt International Company operating wholly offshore has no VAGST registration nexus in Samoa.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, government API mandate, or digital stamping requirement exists under Samoan law. Registered suppliers must issue tax invoices (paper or electronic) containing the particulars prescribed under the VAGST Act 2007 and must file VAGST returns and payments through the MFOR e-Services portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under the VAGST Act 2007 to: (i) goods exported from Samoa; (ii) services supplied to a non-resident recipient outside Samoa, including offshore group support, royalties, and hotpot condiment supplies to the overseas branch; and (iii) supplies in connection with foreign-going vessels or aircraft. Over-the-counter dining sales by the overseas restaurant are outside the scope of Samoan VAGST entirely and fall within the host country's VAT/GST system. Where the IC is not registered in Samoa, no Samoan VAGST refund mechanism is triggered; where registered, creditable input tax may be refunded on production of export evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Samoa Customs Export Declaration (electronic customs entry)
Bill of Lading or airway bill evidencing physical export from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank foreign-currency credit advice
Certificate of origin where preferential duty treatment is claimed
Sanitary or phytosanitary certificate for exported food products
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Samoa law does not impose a statutory 180-day FX repatriation deadline; the 180-day figure is applied in this dossier as the prudential compliance benchmark used to substantiate export zero-rating. If MFOR determines that a zero-rating claim is unsupported or fraudulent, the tax is clawed back at the standard 15% rate together with shortfall and late-payment penalties under the Tax Administration Act 2014 and the VAGST Act 2007; deliberate evasion is subject to fines of up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment, and any Samoan registration of the International Company may be suspended.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) acting under the Central Bank Act 1984 and the Exchange Control Act 1976, together with the Foreign Exchange Regulations 1990
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa maintains Article VIII status for current account convertibility, allowing unrestricted payments for trade and services in Samoan Tala (WST). Capital account transactions, including foreign direct investment equity injections, intercompany debt, and issuance of guarantees, require prior CBS approval or notification via authorised dealers. Profit and dividend remittances are permitted for approved investments upon submission of audited financial statements, tax clearance from the Samoa Revenue Authority, and a completed CBS foreign exchange transfer form; no material withholding hurdle applies when the entity is a tax-exempt International Company, but documentary compliance is strictly enforced.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must submit foreign exchange receipts to an authorised dealer in Samoa within 30 days of receipt. All export proceeds received in foreign currency are subject to a mandatory conversion ratio of 100% into WST unless the exporter holds a CBS-approved Foreign Exchange Retention Account or has obtained a specific exemption for reinvestment or payment of approved trade liabilities. Retention privileges are discretionary and require a written application demonstrating underlying commercial need.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (WST/USD) for FDI inflows and Operational Account (WST) for daily treasury and settlement
Capital Escrow Account (WST/USD) and Operational Account (WST) with cross-border trade support
Operational Account (WST) and, upon CBS approval, Foreign Currency Account (USD) for trade settlements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMI licences are not recognised in Samoa. Unlicensed fintech EMIs cannot access the local clearing system, are not authorised dealers under the Exchange Control Act, and may not lawfully open WST-denominated accounts or process Samoan merchant settlements. An overseas-licensed EMI may only serve as an auxiliary payment collection vehicle outside Samoa, with all net funds repatriated through a licensed Samoan commercial bank using a formal wire transfer and CBS purpose code.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is required for the first-time onboarding of a non-resident International Company. At least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner must attend an in-person KYC interview at the selected Samoan bank or, if they are offshore, before a recognised correspondent branch where the bank has an international presence. Remote video onboarding is generally not accepted for non-resident corporate accounts unless the entity has a pre-existing banking relationship; even then, a board resolution, apostilled corporate documents, and notarised UBO forms are mandatory. Samoan banks require original or certified true copies of all constituent documents and a physical visit prior to account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with opaque beneficial ownership and no local commercial substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation; registered memorandum and articles; current Register of Directors, Shareholders, and Ultimate Beneficial Owners; notarised status report from the Samoa International Finance Authority; apostilled passports and proof of residential address for all owners; detailed corporate organogram; and a notarised declaration of source of wealth and source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound equity injection or capital top-up from a third-party jurisdiction pending CBS approval
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolutions approving the capital injection; executed subscription and share allocation agreements; signed FX capital inflow declaration to the Central Bank of Samoa using the prescribed form; proof of tax registration or tax-exempt status certificate; bank reference letters from the remitting institution; and a written narrative tying the funds to the named restaurant expansion project.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume outbound trade payments to hotpot condiment suppliers in China/Hong Kong without visible trade documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed commercial invoices and packing lists; relevant bills of lading / airway bills; purchase orders; supply agreements with fixed terms; documentary evidence of customs clearance; and a 12-month cash flow forecast demonstrating that payment volumes are proportional to restaurant revenue and inventory turnover.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Timely production of audited financial statements after the first year of active treasury operations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Engagement letter with a licensed Samoa auditor; interim management accounts; bank statements covering the entire operating period; annual inventory summary and tax filings; and a board confirmation that annual audited financial statements will be delivered within the standard 12-month filing period or as otherwise required by the tax authority.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity wiring must be directed via SWIFT MT103/MT202 to the entity's WST or USD capital escrow account at an authorised dealer in Samoa. The remittance must designate the CBS purpose code for inward direct investment, typically 'direct investment - equity capital', and must be accompanied by a completed CBS foreign exchange declaration (Form RPE-1 or the current equivalent) submitted by the receiving bank. Prior CBS approval for the investment is required where the aggregate equity injection exceeds the exchange control authorisation threshold; the company must file the relevant application before the funds arrive. For any funding from a related overseas hotpot restaurant, intercompany loan documentation and an intra-group capital transfer application are necessary to prevent misclassification as a trade payment.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Payments to overseas suppliers for hotpot condiments, packaging, and equipment are cleared via SWIFT MT103 messages from the Samoan operational account to the beneficiary's bank. For large or recurring purchases, confirmed irrevocable documentary letters of credit are advised, issued by the Samoan bank and advised/confirmed through a reputable Asian correspondent bank, with documents handled in strict compliance to protect against supply and payment disputes. All outbound wires require a CBS foreign exchange form identifying the trade purpose code and, where the payment is in a foreign currency, the entity must source the funds from an approved foreign currency account or buy WST against the eligible trade invoice. Settlement limits and clearing cut-off times with ANZ and BSP must be monitored to align with Apia business hours and New York/London correspondent deadlines.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore outright forward contract between the company and a CBS-authorised dealer for hedging forecast WST/USD trade payables and receivables up to 12 months, provided the contract is backed by a real underlying trade exposure

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) referencing WST/USD, permitted only where the counterparty is a licensed international bank and the hedge is approved by CBS as a genuine treasury hedge; no speculative positions allowed

Cross-currency interest rate swap (CIRS) for converting an existing foreign-currency intercompany loan into WST-linked obligations, permitted only with a CBS-licensed dealer and prior Central Bank of Samoa capital account approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Licence Renewal Fee (International Company Annual Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary; payment must be made on or before each anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a 10% penalty surcharge; if unpaid for six months after the due date, the Registrar publishes notice in the Samoa Gazette and may administratively strike the company off the International Companies Register, after which assets vest in the State and the company is dissolved.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Register Confirmation and Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed on each incorporation anniversary concurrently with the annual renewal fee; any update due to a shareholding transfer or change of ultimate beneficial owner must be filed within 21 days of the relevant change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance exposes the company to a monetary penalty of up to WST 500 (approximately USD 190) plus daily continuing default fines; persistent default is a criminal offence carrying a fine of up to WST 10,000 (approximately USD 3,700) and may result in suspension of the ability to register share transfers and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: No Annual Tax Return Required — Automatic Tax-Exempt Status Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry for Revenue, Samoa Inland Revenue Service (exempt status conferred by statute through the Registrar of International Companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No filing deadline applies; the International Company is automatically exempt from Samoan income tax for a 20-year period under the International Companies Act, contingent on continuous payment of the annual renewal fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No tax delinquency applies because no tax return is due; however, failure to pay the annual renewal fee suspends the active exempt status, exposes the company to administrative strike-off, and may forfeit the remaining tax-exempt period.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a standard Samoa International Company engaged in overseas dining operations. A mandatory independent audit applies only where the company is licensed as a bank, insurance, trust, or securities business, or where its memorandum/articles expressly require an audit; otherwise, audit is voluntary and typically driven by external lender, investor, or franchisor requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by the Accountants and Auditors Act framework in Samoa; the International Companies Act 1987 does not prescribe a mandatory local GAAP and the company may maintain management accounts in accordance with IFRS basis for an offshore exempt entity.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must file the Beneficial Ownership Register with the Registrar of International Companies on each incorporation anniversary. Any amendment, including any shareholding transfer or change in ultimate beneficial owner, must be reported within 21 days of the transfer; the register must identify each natural person who ultimately owns or controls 25% or more of the issued shares, voting rights, or who otherwise exercises ultimate control. A share transfer is not given legal effect in local corporate records until the amended Beneficial Ownership Register has been lodged by the registered agent. The register is confidential and not available for public inspection.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900 - USD 1,800 per annum (licensed registered office and registered agent in Samoa, including corporate secretarial support, UBO register maintenance, and annual renewal processing)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory for a standard International Company; USD 3,000 - USD 7,000 per annum if an independent IFRS audit is voluntarily commissioned from a Samoa-licensed certified public accounting firm

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a qualifying Samoa International Company; the resident corporate income tax headline rate is 27% but does not apply to the tax-exempt IC vehicle.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Samoan income tax, dividend withholding tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, and estate/gift duty for ICs held by non-residents; no goods and services tax on out-of-scope international supplies; annual government license fee replaces income tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: SICO Annual Return of International Company (prescribed by the Registrar of International Companies; e-filed through the Samoa International Companies Office online registry by a licensed registered agent).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six months after the fiscal year-end; if no fiscal year is specified, within six months after the anniversary of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered legal name of the International Company in capital letters, exactly as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners should enter the English or Romanised registered name; a Chinese-style name is acceptable only if a Romanised alias is registered and filed through the licensed agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part A, Box 2 - Registration Number and Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: SICO registration number and the name of the licensed registered agent responsible for the filing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The resident agent must be a Samoa-licensed corporate services provider; mailing addresses cannot replace the registered office requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part A, Box 3 - Financial Year End
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting reference date used by the IC for financial reporting and annual return cycles.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The overseas restaurant group should align the IC year-end with the foreign operating company’s fiscal year to simplify intercompany reconciliation and transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part B, Box 4 - Shareholder and Director Register
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, shareholdings, appointment dates, and termination dates of directors and shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose ultimate beneficial owners regardless of non-residence; nominee declarations and bearer share arrangements trigger enhanced AML review and may void the tax exemption certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C, Box 5 - Economic Substance Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of the IC’s principal activity, registered premises in Samoa, number of employees, location of director meetings, and category of income earned.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If hotpot restaurant management and decision-making are conducted entirely offshore, declare the IC as a non-resident holding vehicle and do not claim Samoa-resident tax benefits unless substance exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D, Box 6 - Agent Certification and Signature
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration by the licensed registered agent that the return and attachments are true and complete.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident director or shareholder need not attend in person; the licensed agent’s electronic signature and AML verification are required for SICO e-filing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual return and non-compliance attract an initial WST 500 penalty, continuing late fees of WST 50 per day up to WST 5,000, 90-day strike-off notice, registration cancellation, and restoration fees of up to WST 1,000; the registered agent may also be fined for repeated non-filing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% in respect of dividends paid by a Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders; the domestic general dividend withholding rate is 15%, but the IC tax exemption excludes such distributions from Samoan withholding tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because IC dividends are already exempt under domestic law, no treaty relief or Tax Residence Certificate is required for distributions. If a treaty-reduced rate is sought for a Samoan-source interest or royalty payment, the payee must submit a Samoa Tax Residence Certificate, the relevant DTA article claim form, and a beneficial ownership declaration to the Ministry for Revenue through the licensed agent; the claim should be filed before payment or within 12 months of the payment date.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory withholding tax on royalties and interest sourced in Samoa is 15%; under Samoa’s income tax treaties, royalties may be reduced to 5% and interest to 0% where the beneficial owner presents a valid Tax Residence Certificate and meets the limitation of benefits conditions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No codified Local File or Master File threshold is specified in the Samoa International Companies Act; the Samoa tax administration may require contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation where aggregate cross-border related-party transactions exceed WST 1,000,000, particularly for management fees, brand royalties, and hotpot condiment supply arrangements.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa’s Economic Substance Regulations apply to International Companies carrying on relevant activities such as intellectual property holding, banking, insurance, shipping, and headquarters services. An overseas direct-operated hotpot restaurant chain typically does not conduct such relevant activities in Samoa; however, if the IC holds hotpot trade names, recipes, or condiment brand IP and derives royalty income, it must demonstrate management and control in Samoa, adequate premises, local employees, and operating expenditure in accordance with the substance regulations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Tax Exemption Claims
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately concealing Samoan-source income, submitting a false economic substance declaration, or falsely claiming IC tax exemption for income that is not eligible for exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to WST 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 7 years; civil penalty of up to 100% of the tax shortfall plus monthly interest at 1.5%; revocation of the tax exemption certificate and reassessment at the standard 27% corporate rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors knowingly involved are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax and penalties, face director disqualification, and may be subjected to travel restriction orders by Samoan courts until all liabilities are settled.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse and Economic Substance Violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a pure shell with no employees, premises, or board activity while claiming tax exemption, or registering a relevant activity without satisfying the Economic Substance Regulations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Refusal or retroactive denial of tax exemption, strike-off and dissolution of the IC, publication on the SICO non-compliance register, and loss of limited liability protection for secured creditors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false substance declarations may be fined up to WST 500,000 and banned from managing a company for 5 years; shareholders’ assets traceable through nominee arrangements are recoverable under the Proceeds of Crime Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using nominee shareholders or unreported beneficial owners, accepting POS restaurant proceeds into the IC account while knowingly structuring transactions to avoid AML reporting thresholds, or processing condiment royalty payments derived from unlawful activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Samoa’s Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act, entity fines up to WST 2,000,000, individual fines up to WST 500,000, freezing and seizure of funds, and criminal imprisonment up to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and AML compliance officers are personally prosecutable for failing to report suspicious transactions; personal bank guarantees and overseas assets can be subjected to tracing and enforcement through mutual legal assistance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax and Transfer Pricing Misclassification
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying cross-border royalties, interest, or management fees without collecting applicable Samoan withholding tax, or using non-arm’s length pricing for hotpot condiment IP and intercompany restaurant supplies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of up to 100% of the withholding tax not collected, monthly late-payment interest, disallowance of the deduction for the payer, and loss of IC tax exemption for misclassified Samoan-source payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable if they knowingly authorize under-withholding or mispricing, cannot rely on non-resident status to shield personal liability, and may face travel bans and civil restitution until the tax authorities recover the unpaid amount.
